links.comparator_used: Conventional LLMs without retrieval (GPT-4o, Model 4.1, Model 4.5) answering the same 15 implant dentistry questions
links.outcome: Clinical accuracy and fabrication of references and statistics
links.effect: ScholarQA and OpenEvidence: 80.0% accuracy with 0% fabrication. GPT-4o: 82% reference fabrication and 85.7% statistical fabrication. Unprompted GPT-4o accuracy was 33.3%.
links.tradeoff: RAG systems avoided fabricated references but still generated incorrect interpretations. They gained little from evidence-based prompting: OpenEvidence rose to 86.6% and ScholarQA fell to 73.3%.
links.quote: ScholarQA and OpenEvidence both achieved high accuracy (80.0%) with 0% fabrication, while GPT-4o showed high rates of reference (82%) and statistical (85.7%) fabrication.
